name: SpaceABC

SpaceABC is the world's first company providing a personalized nutrition program developed specifically for space travelers and with the usage of space-sustainable food sources. Personalized space nutrition, diet and food for astronauts, space travelers and space tourists including analog astronauts are developed based on the individuals’ gene analysis (nutrigenetics) and provided via a digital, AI based algorithm by SpaceABC. Our mission is to “establish a deep-space nutrition system mitigating disease risks both in Space and on Earth!”, which is led by SpaceABC’s vision of “a world of multiplanetary humans with healthy longevity!”

name: SpaceDreamS

Until now, each launcher has developed its own means of launch, a bit like each aircraft having to develop its own airport. Thanks to its unique know-how in the development of launch bases and launcher implementations, SpaceDreamS is developing a universal spaceport concept that allows the maximum number of resources and therefore investment and operating costs to be shared.

Activities include EM2 optical terminal design, PAT stack development, platform integration for airborne and stratospheric use, and OGS deployment.

SE offers a novel alternative product, Impact2Space (I2S), a composite build based proprietary shear thickening fluids: it has superior impact protection, lighter than aluminium and when combined with Kevlar or Dyneema, can overcome the properties of these fibres.

Green Resilience helps companies anticipate and adapt to climate impacts, while optimizing operations and reducing costs.

name: Spartan Space
description: Spartan Space est une startup française de l'espace deep-tech créée en janvier 2021 par un groupe de 9 ingénieurs, astronautes et architectes internationaux du spatial et sous-marin. La mission de notre entreprise est de développer des habitats ergonomiques, modulables et confortables en tant que service pour permettre de vivre en toute sécurité dans l'espace et sous les océans. Nous nous adressons à un créneau spécifique pour la future exploration lunaire européenne et le besoin d'un refuge sûr pour la communauté internationale dans l'exploration lunaire. Résumé en anglais (max 500 caractères): Spartan Space is a French deep-tech space startup created in January 2021 by a group of 9 international space and underwater engineers, astronauts, and architects. Our company mission is to develop ergonomically designed, modular and comfortable habitats as a service to enable living safely in space and underwater. We address a specific niche needed for future European lunar exploration and the need for a safe haven for the international community in lunar exploration.

name: Spascat Technologies S.L

At SPASCAT, they specialize in designing, developing, and commercializing technological solutions for the industrial sector, particularly in the blue economy, agriculture and livestock, and energy. Through analyzing data collected from Earth observation sources (EO) using Artificial Intelligence and Data Mining algorithms, they offer personalized solutions to meet the specific needs of each client. Their Agile methodology, which is efficient and iterative, enables SPASCAT to deliver solutions in record time, adding value to their clients and improving their operational efficiency.

name: Stoffschmiede GmbH
description: specialized producer of textiles. "Nakt" is brand name for their reusable and washable wipe. The microfiber is free of petrochemical materials and chemicals, and allows dirt to be absorbed better, so effectively that water is sufficient for facial cleansing. In ESA BIC they want to further develop the fiber to be used for clean room atmosphere, e.g. in satellite production. Furthermore, they want to prove if the material of the reusable and washable wipe is particularly suitable for the special case of cleaning towels in manned space flight such as the ISS. Due to the fiber structure, the water can easily evaporate, which causes the towel to dry very fast and gives bacteria and fungi no place to manifest or time to grow.
